title: hideous, fabulous
author: Lionstooth
description:
Entry for ShuffleComp 2024, inspired by these songs from my assigned playlist:
Scattered Pearls - Casiotone for the Painfully Alone
Sugar Water Cyanide - Rebecca Black
Candelabra Cadaver - The Slow Poisoner
Frankenstein - Rina Sawayama

*****

A murder mystery, but what you’re looking for isn’t who’s guilty.

Multiple endings, possibly multiple canons.

Note: aspects of this game rely on color vision. I’m hoping to adapt a more accessible version post-competition.
